_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: A voice cries out in the wilderness.
Prepare the way of the Lord.
Every valley shall be filled, every mountain made low.
Prepare the way of the Lord.
By the tender mercy of our God, the dawn breaks upon us.
Come, let us worship. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Picture a road through a wilderness — washed out, blocked with stone, grown over.
Come, Lord Jesus, come.
Now picture the valleys filling in, the crooked stretches pulled straight, the long way made smooth.
Come, Lord Jesus, come.
This is the work of Advent: clearing a road in us for the One who comes.
Come, Lord Jesus, come.
By the tender mercy of our God, light is dawning for all who sit in shadow.
Come, Lord Jesus, come. Make us ready.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: A voice in the wilderness: make a road.
Come, Lord Jesus, come.
Fill the valleys; smooth the long way home.
Come, Lord Jesus, come.
The dawn breaks by the mercy of our God.
Come, Lord Jesus, come. Amen.
